$comment: H3-Extended mutation manifest — Phase G2 deliverable. Each entry describes a single-line reverse-mutation that, when applied, must cause ctest to go red. Proves the corresponding widening is load-bearing.

mutations.description: Loop-bound widening: cellToBoundary uses effective resolution to drive _faceIjk*ToCellBoundary at ext res. Reverting to H3_GET_RESOLUTION makes ext-cell boundaries collapse to the stock-res-field shape.
Guard-relaxation: getPentagons accepts ext res 16-22. Reverting MAX_H3_EXT_RES → MAX_H3_RES rejects ext-res arguments and breaks F3.
Digit-write widening: cellToParent's sentinel-7 fill loop uses H3_SET_DIGIT_AT_RES (dispatching). Reverting to H3_SET_INDEX_DIGIT does a negative-shift UB when the sentinel range extends past 15.
Digit-read widening: iterators.c::_getResDigit dispatches via H3_GET_DIGIT_AT_RES. Reverting to H3_GET_INDEX_DIGIT mis-reads ext digits and breaks D4-G6 / D4-G7.

Resolution-write widening: cellToCenterChild atomically writes both stock-res field and ext flag via H3_SET_EFFECTIVE_RESOLUTION. Reverting to H3_SET_RESOLUTION leaves the ext flag clear, producing the §6.8 half-state cell.
Ext-init pattern: setH3Index seeds from H3_INIT_EXT for res > 15 so ext digits start at sentinel 7. Reverting to plain H3_INIT leaves ext digits at zero (invalid layout — not sentinel).
